name: Tirano (Italy)
description: Vertical bicolour of red and white, charged at the centre with the crowned municipal arms of Tirano (a castle beneath an eagle on white) within branches.
history: Municipal flag of Tirano, a comune in Lombardy; Italian municipal arms, gonfaloni and flags are granted by decree of the President of the Republic on the advice of the Government's heraldry office. The arms were granted by decree of the President of the Republic on 21 April 1999.

features.role: Tirano arms — castle beneath an eagle on white, crowned, within branches
